mechanism: Replace mixed six-byte DNA hash by collision-free two-bit six-symbol hints for uppercaseACGT and a4096-head table. Preserve dense insertion, no-fold emission, normal PC branches and byte validation.
difference_from_old_work: R14/R17 used a65536-entry multiplied key. New representation eliminates alphabet-key collisions and cuts this table from256KiB to16KiB; no arbitrary delay or search-budget sweep. NonACGT collisions remain possible and require full decode/byte checks.
